optimization_rounds.stop_reason: the round left the sources unchanged

rule_friction.idea: Store s5 (and the state) in the P/M/K sum/difference basis, to drop the per-iteration basis transforms
rule_friction.rule: state layout and headers are fixed, and verify compares states in the spec layout

rule_friction.idea: Overlap the ring buffers so a state's s4 rows alias the previous state's s0 rows, removing the s4 copy
rule_friction.rule: the fixed contiguous state layout of the step routines (the overlap also clobbers the t0 history)

rule_friction.idea: Compute the C product before the t0 step in the solver's fast path (memory reports ~5% from this ordering)
rule_friction.rule: `fom_step_t1` must contain the C product, and the solver may not compute products

rule_friction.idea: Keep the 80 KB bias cache in the workspace instead of a file-static array
Precompute the derived P/M/K tables and taps in `fom_setup` instead of lazily inside the routines
rule_friction.rule: the solver may not read `FOM_MAT_*` data and `fom_ops.c` has no setup hook

rule_friction.idea: Pass scaled bias terms (τ·b0, η·b1) to the step routines instead of materialised bias vectors, so the 82 KB, 64-slot bias cache can go
rule_friction.expected_gain: unknown (bias costs about 3%, plus L1 pressure)

rule_friction.idea: Let `fom_iterate` skip writing the s3 rows (or take a flag saying so), so the fused single-pass iteration can keep the deferred, grouped s3 fold. The fused path would save the recomputed differences and the T0 reloads, about 40 ops and 60 loads per iteration
rule_friction.rule: `fom_iterate` must write the complete new state, and its signature is fixed

rule_friction.idea: Let `fom_step_t1` also return C·s5_next, so the next iteration's cprod is spread through the current iteration's tail
rule_friction.rule: the fixed step signatures and outputs

rule_friction.idea: Change the step/iterate interface so fom_iterate can skip the s3 rows (the fold keeps them) and the fused one-pass iteration can be used
rule_friction.rule: the fixed signatures in include/ and the rule that fom_iterate must compute the whole new state
rule_friction.expected_gain: about 0 us (ties the separate step calls; would only enable later fusion)

rule_friction.idea: Pass b0 and tau into the t0 step instead of a materialized bias vector, which removes the bias cache
rule_friction.rule: the fixed fom_step_t0 signature (bias is a vector)

rule_friction.idea: Run the C·s5 product in float32 or on the SME matrix unit
rule_friction.rule: float64 data type and fixed build flags
